title: Clear the SonarCloud findings left by #49 on core-3.x
body:
#49 failed the SonarCloud gate on new reliability (D) and new maintainability (B, debt ratio 7.34% against the 5% limit).

- Reliability (javabugs:S6466): `StockItemInventoryReport.writeRow` sized its array and wrote its columns from two separate `includeConsumptionInfo()` calls. Both overrides return a constant, so it could not overflow today; it now reads the flag once so the two cannot disagree.
- Maintainability, 403 of the 1179 minutes of new debt: duplicated parameter names in `StockManagementDao` become constants (S1192), `StringBuilder.length() > 0` becomes `!isEmpty()` (S7158), one `String.format("param.%s.value", ...)` becomes concatenation (S9397), and `Stream.toList()` replaces `collect(Collectors.toList())` at 43 sites where the list is only passed to `addAll` or streamed again, never mutated or returned (S6204). The other `Collectors.toList()` sites are left alone because `toList()` returns an unmodifiable list.

Behaviour-preserving: the compiled classes contain the same string constants as before, apart from the one removed format string. `mvn clean install` on Java 21 passes (api 47 tests, omod 6, no failures), same as `core-3.x` without this change.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates stockmanagement so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It is needed by the billing module's Platform 3 upgrade. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, on Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT and webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and `openmrs-bom` is imported.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- Mail: `javax.activation` (compile scope, bundled) is replaced by `jakarta.mail-api` (provided), and `SmtpUtil` uses `jakarta.mail` / `jakarta.activation`.
- javax.persistence/servlet become jakarta.*, and commons-lang becomes lang3 (`escapeHtml` becomes `escapeHtml4`).
- DAOs: every Hibernate Criteria/Restrictions/Projections use is now HQL with the same semantics:
  - Ordering and paging are unchanged, and counts now go through `DaoBase`'s existing HQL helper.
  - `ilike` is now `lower(x) like lower(:p)`, and `createAlias` is now an inner join. `CriteriaImplWrapper` is removed.
- Session API:
  - `saveOrUpdate` is now `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate` and returns the managed instance; `save` is now `persist`.
  - `createSQLQuery` is now `createNativeQuery`, and the `setString`/`setInteger`/`setDate` calls are now `setParameter`. Dates still use `TemporalType.DATE`.
- Hibernate 7 HQL strictness:
  - Boolean comparisons use `true`/`false`.
  - The `voidedBy` bulk updates bind `getReference(User.class, id)`, not a raw int.
  - `getFlattenedUserRoleScopesByUser` binds the location id as its own parameter. Hibernate 7 rejects comparing `lt.childLocationId` with a `Location`, which broke every permission check that passes a location.
- Entity mappings:
  - `@Enumerated(STRING)` fields get `@JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.VARCHAR)`, like core does.
  - `StockItem.drug` and `OrderItem.stockItem/createdFrom/fulfilmentLocation` are now `@ManyToOne`. Hibernate 7 adds a UNIQUE constraint for `@OneToOne`, which the schema never had.
- REST resources now include `"3.*"` in `supportedOpenmrsVersions`; before, every resource was "Unknown resource" on 3.0. The Swagger `getGETModel` overrides are kept, since REST 5.0.0 still has Swagger.
- webservices.rest 3.2.0 and later no longer validate the resource delegate on create and update (RESTWS-1016), and core only validates `OpenmrsObject`s. The six resources whose delegate is a DTO now call `ValidateUtil.validate(delegate)` in `save()`. Without it, creating a stock operation fails on the NOT NULL `at_location_id` column, because the validator is what fills in `atLocationUuid`.
- New liquibase changeset `stockmanagement-2026-10-02-scheduler-task-creator`, guarded by `columnExists`:
  - Core 3.0 maps `TaskDefinition.creator` to the new `scheduler_task_config.creator` column. The module's task inserts only set `created_by`.
  - The changeset copies `created_by` into `creator` for this module's three tasks.
  - With a null creator, the start-on-startup "Asynchronous Report Generation And Batch Jobs" task crashes core master's `JobRunrSchedulerService.onStartup` with a NullPointerException, and OpenMRS fails to start. The core-side null-safety fix is tracked separately.
- Tests are migrated to JUnit 5. CI (`release.yml`, Bamboo) uses JDK 21. `EntityUtil` is no longer kept in a static field, because its entities outlived the session that loaded them. The omod gets the api module's test dependencies and its first test.

## Verification
- `mvn clean verify` passes: 47 api tests and 6 omod tests.
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8) with legacyui, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT, htmlwidgets, idgen, event and teleconsultation:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
  - The new change

title: (fix) O3-5811: Fix MySQL FK constraint error on stockmgmt_user_role_scope.role
body:
## Summary
Fixes O3-5811. Stock Management failed to start on some MySQL/MariaDB installations because `stockmgmt_user_role_scope.role` and core's `role.role` could have mismatched character sets/collations, causing the FK `stockmgmt_user_role_scope_role_fk` to fail on creation.

## Root cause
Core doesn't pin a charset for `role.role` (plain `VARCHAR(50)`), so it inherits whatever the database default was when core created the table — varies by installation (`utf8mb3`, `utf8mb4`, `latin1`, etc.).

## Fix
Added a changeset that runs before the FK is created. It reads `role.role`'s actual charset/collation via `information_schema` and applies the same to `stockmgmt_user_role_scope.role` via a dynamically-built `ALTER TABLE` — no hardcoded assumption.

- Scoped to MySQL/MariaDB via `<dbms type="mysql,mariadb"/>` — skipped entirely on PostgreSQL.
- Doesn't touch the existing FK changeset, so already-working upgrades are unaffected.
- Only changes column storage/comparison rules, not data — idempotent, safe to re-run.
- Explicit no-op `<rollback>`: there's no single "previous" state to revert to, and reverting could reintroduce the incompatibility.

## Testing performed
- `mvn clean package` — build succeeds, changelog parses.
- Reproduced the original bug (latin1 column vs utf8mb3 core), confirmed the new changeset fixes it and the FK is created.
- Simulated an upgrade from a broken install — starts cleanly, FK created, data preserved.
- Re-ran migrations — no errors (idempotent).
- PostgreSQL — skipped via `dbms` precondition.
- Verified the approach handles utf8mb4 and MariaDB collations correctly by tracing through the dynamic lookup logic against those fixtures.

## Related issues 
https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5811 
Parent: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-4139

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests

title: O3-5519: Add BOT_GH_TOKEN to build workflow secrets
body:
## Description
Ticket Link - https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5519
Ticket ID - O3-5519

## Summary
The shared OWASP Dependency Check workflow (openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows) has been updated to automatically push generated vulnerability reports to the central dashboard repository (openmrs-contrib-dependency-vulnerability-dashboard). To support this, the reusable workflow now requires the GH_BOT_TOKEN secret to be passed by calling repositories. Without it, the workflow cannot push reports to the dashboard.

## Change
Added `BOT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.OMRS_BOT_GH_TOKEN }}` to the secrets block in `.github/workflows/build.yml`.
